analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (₩26,310) above SMA5 (₩25,812), below SMA20 (₩28,079): short-term rise followed by mid-term trend decline
· Significantly below SMA100 (₩34,780) and SMA200 (₩36,518): long-term trend weakness
· 52-week position (23.9%): approaching historical low levels
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (42.8→41.7): neutral zone continuation, insufficient oversold escape
· MACD histogram trajectory (histogram -37.5263→7.1924): transition from negative to positive, improvement signal
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band ₩28,079): consolidation near mid-band, 34.92% band width indicating reduced volatility
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (₩25,055): basis for Higher Low formation relative to 5-day low (₩24,647)
· Swing resistance (₩30,570): potential for trend reversal upon breakout
· 5-day high (₩29,050)/low (₩24,647), 20-day high (₩33,675)/low (₩23,720): consolidation phase without clear trend formation
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.77): contraction compared to 5-day average, reduced confidence in price movement
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation): RSI neutral, MACD shows improvement signal but pending buy entry due to lack of volume
